scripts.js:watch: npm run js:build && chokidar "resources/js/*.js" -c "npm run js:build"
scripts.fonts:watch: npm run assets:copy && chokidar "resources/fonts/*" -c "npm run assets:copy"
scripts.build: npm run css:build && npm run js:build && npm run assets:copy
scripts.fonts:subset: for f in 400:Inter_24pt-Regular 500:Inter_24pt-Medium 700:Inter_28pt-Bold 800:Inter_28pt-ExtraBold; do pyftsubset ./resources/fonts/source/${f#*:}.ttf --unicodes='U+0000-00FF,U+0131,U+0152-0153,U+02BB-02BC,U+02C6,U+02DA,U+02DC,U+2000-206F,U+2074,U+20AC,U+2122,U+2190-2199,U+2212,U+2215,U+2713,U+2715' --layout-features='kern,liga,calt,tnum,ccmp,locl,mark,mkmk' --flavor=woff2 --output-file=./resources/fonts/inter-${f%%:*}.woff2; done
